howTitle.en: Why the answer is min(space, weight)
howTitle.zh: 为什么答案是 min(空间, 重量)

howP.en: A container is constrained twice: by internal volume and by payload. Light bulky cargo hits the space ceiling long before the weight limit; dense cargo does the opposite and you end up with a half-empty container at 26 tonnes. This tool computes both ceilings and returns the lower one — that is the number you can actually load. It also checks all six ways to turn a carton, because the difference between 1,050 and 1,180 cartons on a 40HQ is one rotation.
howP.zh: 柜子有两道上限：内容积和限重。泡货先撞空间，重货先撞重量——后者经常是半柜货就 26 吨了。这里两个上限都算，取小的那个，才是真能装的数量。六种摆放方向全部遍历，因为 40HQ 从 1050 箱到 1180 箱，差别往往就是转个方向。

q.en: Why is my container never as full as this says?
q.zh: 为什么实际装不到这个数？

a.en: Because real loading is not a perfect grid. Cartons crush, pallets take space, doors are narrower than the floor, and the last row often does not fit. Take 90–95% of this number as a practical plan, and always leave the door end loose.
a.zh: 因为真实装柜不是整齐的格子。箱子会压塌、托盘占位、柜门比柜底窄、最后一排常常塞不进。按这个数的 90–95% 做计划，柜门那一端永远留活口。

a.en: Only in height — 2698 vs 2393 mm, about 12.7% more volume, same floor. If your cartons are short and you cannot stack another layer, HQ buys you nothing and you pay for air.
a.zh: 只多在高上——2698 对 2393，多约 12.7% 体积，底面积一样。如果箱子矮、又码不下一层，HQ 一点用没有，你是在为空气付钱。

q.en: Should I use internal or external carton dimensions?
q.zh: 用箱子内尺寸还是外尺寸？

a.en: External, always, and measure a few real cartons rather than trusting the spec sheet. Corrugated bulges — a nominal 600 mm carton is often 610 mm at the belly, and 10 mm across a container width costs you a whole column.
a.zh: 一律用外尺寸，而且拿几个实物量，别信规格书。纸箱会鼓——标称 600 的箱子腰上常有 610，柜宽方向差 10mm 就少一整列。
